subject: Request: Vyant hosted API rate concession (25% for year 1)
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@vyanthealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Vyant hosted API rate concession (25% for year 1)

Team —

Quick background: Vyant Health (Elena Morales, product) is moving a large multi-region ingestion pipeline onto our Hosted API. They committed to a 12-month ramp and are forecasting ~9–12B tokens/month by Q4 if initial performance and pricing are acceptable. They’ve asked for a 25% off list price for the first 12 months to make the economics work for their procurement.

High-level commercial asks from Vyant:
- 25% off Hosted API usage for 12 months (apply to generation tokens only)
- 12-month minimum term with quarterly usage review
- Net 45 payment terms; procurement prefers consolidated invoice

Attachments: Vyant_Q3_usage_forecast.xlsx, Vyant_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf

Why this matters:
- Expected run rate >$120k/mo in month 4 if forecast holds (annualized ~$1.4m)
- Strategic: pushes usage into our US regions and could be a reference for payers verticals

Ask: Per policy, any concession >20% needs exec sign-off. Ben — can you please confirm deal desk impact and recommend approval threshold? Lauren — flag any procurement/legal blockers. Marissa — looping you for executive approval if we recommend >20%.

I recommend we consider approving up to 25% as a temporary, conditional concession if we get: 12-month commit, a usage floor of 6B tokens/mo starting month 4, and quarterly business reviews with revenue recognition guardrails.

Thanks,
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

On Mon, Aug 9, 2027 at 08:12 AM Elena Morales <elena@vyanthealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Rohan —
> Thanks for the call this morning. To make this an easy procurement approval internally we need a 25% concession for year one. We can sign a 12-month commitment and agree to the usage forecasts attached. Can you escalate to your leadership?
> 
> —Elena
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@vyanthealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Vyant hosted API rate concession (25% for year 1)

Rohan —

Thanks for the write-up and the forecast. Quick deal desk read:
- Forecasted ARR (if realized) would put this in the strategic mid-market tier.
- Margin impact: 25% off on token usage reduces expected unit margin significantly at the projected volumes; however, with a committed minimum and 12-month term the NPV stays healthy.

Our standard concession authority: up to 15% can be approved by deal desk for strategic accounts with a signed MAP and usage floor. Anything >20% must have explicit executive approval (sales leadership or CRO).

Recommended approval language if escalated to execs:
1) Approve 25% off generation tokens for first 12 months only.
2) Require a 12-month minimum commitment with a 6B tokens/month usage floor starting month 4; shortfall invoiced at list price differential.
3) Payment: Net 30 preferred, but we can accept Net 45 for year 1 given procurement constraints; require pre-approved finance onboarding and credit check.
4) Limit the concession to Hosted API (no Dedicated or Private pricing allowances).

Notes: Legal will need to review amendment and add a revert clause (auto revert to list upon non-payment or early termination). Include finance in the DocuSign flow.

Ben
Ben Carter
Lead, Strategic Deals (Deal Desk)
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Folks —

I reviewed the deal desk recommendation and the forecast. Given the strategic nature and the projected ARR, I approve a 25% concession on Hosted API generation tokens for the first 12 months, subject to the following binding conditions:

1) Signed amendment that includes the MAP attached, a 12-month commitment, and a 6B tokens/month minimum starting month 4.
2) Finance to complete standard credit onboarding and accept Net 45 for year 1 only. Any late payments will trigger immediate reversion to list pricing and potential collection terms.
3) Concession limited to Hosted API SKU; no discounts applied to Dedicated or Private offerings.
4) Quarterly business reviews (QBRs) for the first year with product and sales engagement; if usage deviates by >30% vs forecast for two consecutive quarters, concession auto-revokes.

Please have Legal and Finance draft the amendment and a single DocuSign envelope for Elena and Vyant procurement. Ben — please update the HubSpot deal with the approval and attach this email. Rohan — proceed to capture the signature and confirm timeline to Elena.

I’m attaching a signed approval stub for the record: exec_approval_signed_stub.pdf

-Marissa
